big: Two clients hold the same fund. One is in the direct plan, one in the regular plan. Same portfolio, same manager. Yet their returns differ every year by roughly the difference in cost. Where did the gap come from?

lines: Same fund, same manager. Why do I earn less?
Your plan pays the distributor's trail commission, and that cost comes out of the NAV daily. In return you may get advice and service. Whether it is worth it depends on what you need.
